title: Unwrapping a cube (xatlas)
description: xatlas parameterizes and packs a cube mesh into a texture atlas. The prepared chart shows the actual seam splits and UV triangles.
description_ko: xatlas로 큐브 메시를 파라미터화하고 텍스처 아틀라스에 배치했어요. 실제 이음새 분할과 UV 삼각형을 살펴보세요.
prompt: Unwrapping a cube. Inspect the locally generated results and rerun the included recipe when changing simulation inputs.
made_with: xatlas==0.0.11, numpy==2.2.6; executed locally on macOS arm64
summary: xatlas parameterizes and packs a cube mesh into a texture atlas. The prepared chart shows the actual seam splits and UV triangles.

tool_about: xatlas parameterizes and packs a cube mesh into a texture atlas. The prepared chart shows the actual seam splits and UV triangles. The viewer only reads prepared data; computation is in the recipe.
